question.worked_solution:
The difference of cubes formula is given by

$$
{a}^{3}-{b}^{3}=(a-b)({a}^{2}+ab+{b}^{2}).
$$

Notice that all of the terms have a common factor of $8.$ To simplify the computation, we can factor out the $8,$ as follows:

$$
\frac{8}{{t}^{6}}-1000=8(\frac{1}{{t}^{6}}-125)
$$

The expression in parentheses can be written as a difference of cubes:

$$
8(\frac{1}{{t}^{6}}-125)=8({(\frac{1}{{t}^{2}})}^{3}-{5}^{3})
$$

Now, we factor the expression in parentheses using the difference of cubes formula:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{8}{{t}^{6}}-1000 & =8({(\frac{1}{{t}^{2}})}^{3}-{5}^{3}) \\  & =8(\frac{1}{{t}^{2}}-5)({(\frac{1}{{t}^{2}})}^{2}+\frac{1}{{t}^{2}}\cdot 5+{5}^{2}) \\  & =8(\frac{1}{{t}^{2}}-5)(\frac{1}{{t}^{4}}+\frac{5}{{t}^{2}}+25)\end{aligned}
$$
